title: The platform at rest: cluster, real and simulated GPUs, Kueue, the second scheduler, accounting
purpose: Check that the platform is what section 2 says before testing behaviour: a standard EKS cluster with a system and a real-GPU node group, 16 simulated 8-GPU nodes in two blocks of two racks, Kueue with the topology and flavors, a second scheduler with two GPU profiles, DCGM on the real GPUs, the accounting service, and no workload.

checks.description: the cluster is ACTIVE on Kubernetes 1.37, standard EKS (Auto Mode off)
checks.because: Terraform creates a plain cluster with managed node groups and no compute configuration.

checks.description: 16 simulated nodes with 8 GPUs each (128 GPUs) in 2 blocks of 2 racks, all Ready; 2 real one-GPU nodes; 2 system nodes
checks.because: KWOK keeps the Node objects up/make_fleet.py created Ready; the device plugin advertises the real GPUs.

checks.description: Kueue runs with the topology ds17-fabric, two flavors over the simulated fleet and three priority classes
checks.because: The platform layer creates them after the Kueue chart is ready.

checks.description: a second kube-scheduler runs with a bin-packing (MostAllocated) and a spreading (LeastAllocated) GPU profile
checks.because: Both profiles weight GPUs 10 to 1 over CPU and memory and differ only in strategy.

checks.description: DCGM runs on both real GPU nodes, and the accounting service is sampling
checks.because: The chart's DaemonSet selects the GPU pool; the accounting service samples every 10 s.
